name: University of Oxford
type: higher education institution; public university; collegiate university; educational organization; exempt charity
text: The University of Oxford is a collegiate research university in Oxford, England. There is evidence of teaching as early as 1096, making it the oldest university in the English-speaking world and the world's second-oldest university in continuous operation. It grew rapidly from 1167, when Henry II prohibited English students from attending the University of Paris.

depictions.name: University
depictions.text: The University is an imposing structure, its monumental size allowing it to be clearly seen from all the way across the already-expansive town. Serving as the setting for "The Way of Roses", it is an enormous building once dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge, now since conquered by the Inquisition. It is here that Amicia has traveled across the town to retrieve a book of forbidden alchemical knowledge: the Sanguinis Itinera.
